snippet.title: Manifest Anything Trailer
snippet.description:
Manifest Anything is an AI-powered sandbox where players can create, explore, and play games generated in real time.

Built on Unreal Engine 5, Manifest Anything lets players describe ideas using natural language and voice, then work alongside an AI companion to assemble worlds, mechanics, and gameplay systems as they go. Whether you’re experimenting with environments, testing gameplay concepts, or shaping a new experience from scratch, the platform is designed to make game creation accessible without requiring traditional development skills.

This Early Access version introduces the core creation workflow, including a project creator, playable demo environments, and AI-assisted tools that help guide players through building and experimenting in real time. As development continues, the platform will expand with additional maps, assets, gameplay systems, and deeper AI-driven generation.

Manifest Anything is built for creators, tinkerers, and players who want to explore what it feels like to build a game from an idea — and then immediately play it.

🟢 Coming Soon on Steam (Early Access)
👉 Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/

🌐 Official Website: https://www.manifestanything.ai

🎮 Built with Unreal Engine 5
🎙️ Voice & AI-assisted creation
🧠 Real-time gameplay generation
